## Loading Libraries

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("janitor")
library("patchwork")
library("broom")
library("curl")
```

## Loading the data

```{r}
base_url    <- "https://github.com/"
target_file <- "rforbiodatascience26/group_11_project/raw/main/data/Breast%20Cancer%20METABRIC.csv"
output_file <- "../data/Breast_Cancer_METABRIC.csv"

curl_download(url = str_c(base_url,
                          target_file),
              destfile = output_file)

brca_raw <- read_csv("../data/Breast_Cancer_METABRIC.csv",
                     na = c("", "NA", "N/A", "?", "null"))
```
